messages:
Yara Kapoor: Hey all! Im Yara, starting today on DevEx. Bay Area hybrid, hobby sneaker collector (tiny problem with closet space). Bringing an extra pair of comfy trainers if anyone wants to swap sizes for office days. :sneaker:
Devon Blake: Welcome Yara!! :tada: Im Devon from Eng-Infra. Which size are you packing? I might trade for something lower-profile.
Yara Kapoor: Thanks Devon  Im a 8.5 US. Mostly comfy neutrals, one pair of bright orange ones for mood.
Nina Chen: Hi Yara  welcome! Im Nina in Customer Success. Im a size 8 and love trying new comfy shoes. Also curious about office lockers and whether we can leave swaps there?
Hiro Tanaka: Hey Yara, Hiro here (Product). We usually stash extra shoes or spare chargers in locker row F; just label your stuff. Also quick heads-up: the floor tends to be sticky on rainy days so grippy soles recommended.
Devon Blake: Also welcome-bot just posted your intro ":wave: Say hi to Yara Kapoor - DevEx - Bay Area"
Yara Kapoor: Thanks Hiro and Nina  Ill label the sneakers if anyone wants to try them tomorrow. Also unrelated Q: is there a snack preference poll? I have a big tin of masala peanuts I can bring but can keep them separate if folks are nut-sensitive.
Nina Chen: We have a GF+nut-free shelf labeled. If you bring masala peanuts maybe bring a note and keep them on the labeled shelf. Ill bring oat cookies to balance it out.
Hiro Tanaka: Quick poll: rooftop hang Friday 5:30? React with :sunny: for yes or :house: for later.
Devon Blake: :sunny: Im in.
Yara Kapoor: :sunny: Ill bring an orange pair as trade Bait  see you all then!
